title: Genuine move to her own account at another bank
payerBackground: A retired solicitor, 72, who reads the money pages and moves her savings whenever a better rate appears. She has done this four times in six years and finds the questioning mildly patronising.
realReason: Moving her own savings to her own newly opened account at another bank, for a better fixed rate. This is word for word the cover story the scammers use, said by someone for whom it is true.
